'''L4-B5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that belonged to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Pell (Nautolan)|Pell]] of [[Republic Army]]'s [[Fifth Squadron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and Pell crashed on the [[Road to Glory]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]'s [[Eastern Ice Shelf]], and L4-B5 raced back to the [[Republic base camp]] to plea for help for its master from Republic aligned individuals.<ref name="SWTOR" />
